# BetterNet — Copilot instructions

Read these before editing code in this repo:

1. **[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)** — monorepo layout, package roles, specs/status workflow, build commands, and agent conventions.
2. **[bn-extension/code-guidelines.md](../bn-extension/code-guidelines.md)** — code style and review principles (KISS, DRY, modularity, comments, refactoring).

When working on `bn-extension`, also check `bn-extension/status.md` and relevant specs under `bn-extension/specs/`.
